item.title: Mindfulness Sunday Meditation: Cultivating Consciousness — Sun Aug 16, 9:00 AM
item.description: Meditate with a Monk in Sonoma County Join us for a transformative workshop on mindfulness meditation and cultivating consciousness. Dive deep into the teachings of Theravada Buddhism, focusing on insight meditation to develop a clear understanding of the nature of the mind and consciousness. This workshop will include guided meditation sessions to help you strengthen your meditation practice and cultivate mindfulness in your daily life. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced meditator, this workshop offers a welcoming space to explore the depths of your own consciousness and enhance your spiritual journey. Come together with like-minded individuals to deepen your practice and connect with the wisdom of Theravada Buddhism, and provide an opportunity to deepen mindfulness, wisdom, and inner stillness. Our sessions are led by Bhikkhunis closely associated with our Dhammadharini Sangha. Check out the [recording from the past event](https://youtube.com/live/s07U2kzWoWk?feature=share)

item.title: Tuesday Night Fitness Hike: 5+ Fast Miles, Downtown Petaluma and Western Hills — Tue Aug 18, 6:00 PM
item.description:
"SONOMA COUNTY OUTDOORS" WARNING: THE TUESDAY NIGHT FITNESS HIKE IS AN AEROBIC, FAST-PACED URBAN HIKE! WE TARGET A PACE OF 16-MINUTES PER MILE WITH ONLY BRIEF STOPS (TO REGROUP AS NEEDED). OUR SUMMER ROUTE INCLUDES THE HILLS IN HELEN PUTNAM PARK (740 FT. ELEVATION GAIN), AND OUR WINTER ROUTE EXPLORES THE WATER TANKS (690 FT. ELEVATION GAIN). IF YOU FIND YOU ARE HAVING DIFFICULTY KEEPING UP WITH THE LEADERS IN THIS GROUP, PLEASE USE THE OPT-OUT POINT AT THE FIRST MILE OF THE HIKE! ANOTHER OPTION IS OUR WEDNESDAY NIGHT WALK FOR A MORE MODERATE PACE. THANK YOU FOR HELPING ME KEEP THIS HIKE AN AEROBIC WORKOUT!
NOTE: The Tuesday Night Fitness Hike is posted on the SCO Calendar every week. Steve Tubbs is shown as the host each week but he might, or might not, show up to the event. This is, more often than not, a small group of regular, fit walkers who show up on time every Tuesday night to enjoy this rigorous walk. We leave promptly at 6:10 pm from the Kentucky Street entrance to the LanMar

item.title: Wednesday Night Walk: Petaluma Downtown & Riverfront — Wed Aug 19, 6:00 PM
item.description:
"SONOMA COUNTY OUTDOORS" Wednesday Night Walk: Petaluma Downtown and Riverfront
* Want to walk for fitness and exercise? * New to walking and want to build up stamina? * Like a slower pace than our Tuesday Night Fitness Hike? * Would walking with a committed group of walkers help you?
If you said yes to any of these, then the Wednesday Night Walk in Petaluma is for you. We start at Aqus Cafe and take in the West Side of town, including some of Downtown, the Waterfront and a few of the Historic home of old Petaluma. We walk about 3-1/2 to 4-1/2 miles depending on weather conditions and the pace of the group that night.
Afterward if you have the time, join us at Aqus Cafe for a bite to eat and some liquid refreshment before heading home. Aqus Cafe is a true gem of a gathering place, restaurant, coffee house, and live music venue. But it's the people on either side of the counter that make this place so special.
DETAILS:
* Meetup time: 6:00pm (we hike at 6:10 sharp) * Meetup location

item.title: Merging Music & Humanity — Sun Aug 9, 7:00 PM — Polly Klaas Community Theater
item.description: Turn your Sunday into a night to remember! Join us on August 9th at 7 PM for an unforgettable evening of music with one of New Orleans’ most distinctive pianists—Tom McDermott. Proceeds from this concert will directly help Global Healing’s ongoing efforts in Roatán, Honduras, continuing to support fire recovery and providing the assistance needed to facilitate the hospital’s services. In 2024, a shocking fire ravaged the sole public hospital on Roatán. Home to Global Healing’s pediatric clinic for over the past two decades, the hospital was vital for emergency care for both children and adults, performing urgent surgeries, and providing maternity services—like life-saving C-sections. Reduced to ashes, the hospital and clinic left Honduras with even fewer means to deliver essential medical care. All medical equipment was lost, and recovery is still ongoing. Eric Scher and Barbara Stowe continue to travel to Roatán often, having helped set up a provisional hospital in a former Adventist

item.title: West Side Stories Petaluma — Wed Aug 12, 7:00 PM — Polly Klaas Community Theater
item.description:

item.title: Transit Month Read and Ride — Fri Sep 4, 11:00 AM — Copeland St Bus Stop
item.description: Come ride the bus with us! We’ll meet at the Copeland St. bus stop at 11:00 AM to ride the westbound Route 11 loop together with special guest Maria Arce, Division Manager of Petaluma Transit. Maria will share what’s happening with our local bus system and offer her reflections on September’s Cool Book Club selection, Confessions of a Recovering Engineer. After our 30-minute scenic ride, we’ll land at Grand Central Café for coffee, conversation, and a chance to give Petaluma Transit some direct feedback. Never ridden the bus before? Join us to kick off Transit Month with a Cool Books discussion on 9/1 to whet our appetites for the bus. item.title: A Benefit Concert with Oscar Rossignoli — Sat Sep 19, 8:00 PM — Polly Klaas Community Theater
item.description: “I have learned not to say so-and-so is “the best”, but I will surely say Oscar, is my FAVORITE, Nola pianist. Am I’m hardly alone.” – Tom McDermott New Orleans Ragtime, Piano Master Honduran born, pianist and composer OSCAR ROSSIGNOLI, settled in New Orleans LA in 2014, and has taken his place as first-call pianist in the city. With a strong foundation in classical piano, Oscar was drawn as well, to the fearless improvisation of the Latin Jazz masters like Chucho Valdez and Michel Camilo, and to the tremendously impactful playing of icons of American jazz, like Oscar Peterson. And once in New Orleans, he couldn’t help but be affected by the sounds of Professor Longhair and James Booker that flow through the Crescent City, at all hours of the day and night. Oscar’s extraordinary contribution to whatever musical setting he finds himself in, has resulted in his status as first-call pianist, in the city. This workshop will include guided meditation sessions to help you strengthen your meditation practice and cultivate mindfulness in your daily life. item.title: Simple Sitting Meditation — Wed Jul 29, 8:00 AM
item.description:
The Mindful Stream (CA) In these sessions, I will be doing guided meditations where we simply sit and notice what arises.
There is no agenda and no plan for how these sessions unfold. I might start off simply by asking us to notice what is already present. By becoming aware of what’s going on in our heads and in our body.
Then, the meditation may take on a life of its own.
Our job is to simply be present to what arises. We may notice the mind moving and chattering about. Or we may notice that it’s completely silent.
The goal here, if there is one, is to simply let ourselves be as we are.
Source: Meetup: Mindful Petaluma

item.title: Wednesday Night Walk: Petaluma Downtown & Riverfront — Wed Aug 12, 6:00 PM
item.description:
"SONOMA COUNTY OUTDOORS" Wednesday Night Walk: Petaluma Downtown and Riverfront
* Want to walk for fitness and exercise? * New to walking and want to build up stamina? * Like a slower pace than our Tuesday Night Fitness Hike? * Would walking with a committed group of walkers help you?
If you said yes to any of these, then the Wednesday Night Walk in Petaluma is for you. We start at Aqus Cafe and take in the West Side of town, including some of Downtown, the Waterfront and a few of the Historic home of old Petaluma. We walk about 3-1/2 to 4-1/2 miles depending on weather conditions and the pace of the group that night.
Afterward if you have the time, join us at Aqus Cafe for a bite to eat and some liquid refreshment before heading home. Aqus Cafe is a true gem of a gathering place, restaurant, coffee house, and live music venue. But it's the people on either side of the counter that make this place so special.
